training.normalization: original four dynamic training trajectories only; frozen for both arms
training.dynamic_loss: mean squared per-joint normalized point inverse-dynamics residual
training.static_loss: mean over all 25 equally weighted static poses and six joints of ((Ghat - equilibrium_drive_torque) / original_torque_scale)^2

static_training.label_source: MuJoCo algebraic equilibrium drive torque, checked against inverse and forward dynamics; synthetic gravity supervision, not measured controller holding data
static_training.pose_weighting: uniform over distinct configurations; no replicated samples

static_evaluation.primary: 48 non-center previously diagnosed configurations, disjoint from new static training poses
static_evaluation.status: Previously analyzed diagnostic configurations, not untouched holdout

motion_evaluation.primary_endpoint: Fx RMSE on each complete core-motion window, reported separately by trajectory
motion_evaluation.secondary_endpoints: all six components: RMSE, bias and absolute error peak, all original five windows
motion_evaluation.KF: original native R=Mhat Sigma_v Mhat^T rule, original Q and initial covariance rule; continuous from t=0 without resets or tuning
motion_evaluation.status: Existing development/diagnostic trajectories; excluded from dynamic gradient updates but previously analyzed

load_regression.purpose: Report known-load amplitude/error/delay and cross-axis changes as regression checks, not independent moving-contact validation

reporting.decision: Report paired changes in gravity and motion endpoints, retain every direction of deterioration; no automatic overall-win or scientific-acceptance label

disclosures: A new treatment adds 25 synthetic static equilibrium labels and one fixed loss term; architecture, dynamic data, initialization, dynamic batch schedule and update count stay paired
Static labels supply additional gravity information from the simulator; no direct inertia, Coriolis or friction labels enter training
Shared hidden layers allow gravity supervision to change learned inertia indirectly; no shared-layer freezing is introduced
One seed and previously analyzed evaluation records support an EXPLORE comparison only
Actual native KF R can differ between arms through learned M; this estimates the effect of the trained model in the unchanged pipeline
User approved execution of this fixed design; use explicit staged request and retain all outcomes without hyperparameter changes
